ruleDefinitions.name: File and Directory Discovery - Linux
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects usage of system utilities such as "find", "tree", "findmnt", etc, to discover files, directories and network shares.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\/file$") AND process_command_line = RGX("(.){200,}")) OR (process_path = RGX("\\/ls$") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-R.*")) OR process_path = RGX("\\/find$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/tree$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/findmnt$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/mlocate$"))
